description: This file defines the MemEntryImpl class, which implements cache entry management for an in-memory disk cache, supporting sparse and non-sparse entries, with methods for data access, sparse data handling, and cache state updates.

classes.name: MemEntryImpl
classes.description: A class representing a cache entry in a memory-only cache, supporting sparse and non-sparse data, with methods for data access, state updates, and cache management.

methods.name: InUse
methods.description: Checks if the cache entry is currently in use.

methods.name: UpdateStateOnUse
methods.description: Updates the cache entry's position in the LRU list and timestamps based on modification status.

methods.name: Doom
methods.description: Marks the cache entry as deleted.

methods.name: GetKey
methods.description: Returns the key associated with the cache entry.

methods.name: GetDataSize
methods.description: Returns the size of data at a given index.

methods.name: ReadData
methods.description: Reads data from the cache entry.

methods.name: WriteData
methods.description: Writes data to the cache entry.

methods.name: ReadSparseData
methods.description: Reads sparse data from the cache entry.

methods.name: WriteSparseData
methods.description: Writes sparse data to the cache entry.

methods.name: GetAvailableRange
methods.description: Gets the available data range in the cache entry.

methods.name: CouldBeSparse
methods.description: Checks if the entry could be sparse.

methods.name: ReadyForSparseIO
methods.description: Prepares the entry for sparse I/O.

methods.name: SetLastUsedTimeForTest
methods.description: Sets the last used time for testing purposes.
